contract.intent: Add a safe replacement-sample workflow that preserves blocked benchmark evidence and prevents accidental overwrites.

outcomes.statement: The benchmark CLI can prepare one task-specific replacement sample without overwriting an existing sample.
Existing blocked evidence remains addressable while replacement preparation creates a distinct sample directory.
The replacement workflow and its non-comparability implications are documented.

docs.reason: No documentation behavior is changed in this data-collection phase.

checks.command: node --check scripts/run-agentskit-os-harness-benchmark.mjs && node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const args=['scripts/run-agentskit-os-harness-benchmark.mjs','--prepare','--task-id','feat-formatter','--sample','4','--phase-root','.codex/verification/phase-40/replacement']; const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,args,{encoding:'utf8'}); if(r.status!==0) process.exit(r.status??1); const x=JSON.parse(r.stdout.trim().split(/\r?\n/).at(-1)); const collision=spawnSync(process.execPath,args,{encoding:'utf8'}); const ok=x.taskCount===1 && x.sampleCount===1 && x.tasks?.[0]?.sample===4 && x.tasks?.[0]?.taskId==='feat-formatter' && collision.status!==0 && collision.stderr.includes('replacement sample already exists'); if(!ok) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['replacement-runner'],task:x.tasks[0],collisionRejected:true}))"

node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const root='.codex/verification/phase-39/harness/runs'; const blocked=['test-coverage-gap/sample-3','feat-formatter/sample-2']; const ok=blocked.every(p=>{const d=root+'/'+p; return fs.existsSync(d) && fs.readdirSync(d+'/runs',{withFileTypes:true}).some(e=>e.isDirectory())}); if(!ok) process.exit(1); if(!fs.existsSync('.codex/verification/phase-40/replacement/configs/feat-formatter-sample-4.json')) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['history-preservation'],blockedSamples:blocked,replacement:'feat-formatter/sample-4'}))"
